# Diamond Jubilee Hotel Management Services (DJHMS)

> Diamond Jubilee Hotel Management Services (DJHMS) is a premier hospitality management company based in Mumbai, India. DJHMS delivers comprehensive hotel operations, hospitality partnerships, service quality control, and guest satisfaction across its managed property portfolio.

## Overview
- Company Name: Diamond Jubilee Hotel Management Services (DJHMS)
- Tagline: Hospitality | Management | Excellence
- Headquarters: 819, Sagar Tech Plaza - A, A.K. Road, Sakinaka Junction, Andheri Kurla West, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400072, India
- Website: https://djhms.in
- Official Email: info@djhms.in
- Phone: +91 9892912289

## Managed Properties
- [Hotel Maharana Inn](https://djhms.in/properties): Located in Chembur, Mumbai. Features contemporary rooms, banquet facilities, fine dining restaurant, and 24-hour guest services. Official website: https://www.hotelmaharana.com
- [Hotel Sitara Residency](https://djhms.in/properties): Located in Kalamboli, Navi Mumbai. Provides executive accommodations, transit accessibility, and hospitality operations for corporate and leisure travellers.

## Core Services
- [Hotel Management & Operations](https://djhms.in/services): Turnkey operational leadership, front office management, housekeeping, food and beverage operations, and preventive property maintenance.
- [Guest Satisfaction & Service Quality](https://djhms.in/services): Standardized hospitality training, continuous guest feedback systems, and operational excellence audits.
- [Business Partnerships & Hospitality Solutions](https://djhms.in/services): Strategic asset management, revenue management, owner reporting, and hotel partnership arrangements.
